stories.title: Fixed prompt scheduling bugs
stories.summary: Barry rebuilt the prompt scheduling system to calculate week position purely from time, preventing schedule drift and back-filled existing users with a migration.
stories.heading: ✍️ Brief > Problems I solved along the way
stories.quote: I rebuilt it so the week is calculated purely from time (from sign-up to now), so the schedule can no longer drift, and I back-filled existing users with a one-off migration.

stories.title: Fixing data quality issues
stories.summary: Barry identified missing coordinate data and fixed it by requesting geometry projection, ensuring all applications had valid locations. He also addressed unreliable residential unit counts by using LLM extraction from descriptions and refined classification of housing grants.
stories.heading: Data profile — Sprint 1 (8–22 Oct 2026) > National Planning Applications — South Dublin County Council (HOUSE-9) > Top 5 quality issues
stories.quote: Fix (done, 10 Oct): the downloader now requests the geometry projected to ITM (EPSG:2157) and uses it when the columns are blank. Re-profiled: 0 of 33,304 applications have no location... Fix: this is exactly the case for LLM extraction (HOUSE-20):

stories.title: Handled credential exposure incident
stories.summary: Barry rotated all exposed API secrets, rebuilt Git history as a single clean commit, and locked the repository with a strict .gitignore after a secret scanner flagged credentials in an early commit.
stories.heading: ✍️ Brief > Problems I solved along the way
stories.quote: an automated secret scanner flagged API credentials in an early commit. I rotated every exposed secret (Google, Microsoft and Twilio) so the leaked values were dead, rebuilt the Git history as a single clean commit, and locked the repository down

stories.title: Azure sign-in with Entra ID
stories.summary: Barry configured Azure to sign in with Entra ID instead of keys, created identities and roles, updated search service authentication, tested locally, created secrets securely, and set up GitHub OIDC for nightly index refresh without storing Azure secrets in GitHub.
stories.heading: Stage 3: Azure setup > Step 8: Sign in with Entra ID instead of keys (ASK-8)
stories.quote: The nightly index refresh signs in with GitHub OIDC (ASK-34), so GitHub stores no Azure secret at all. Terraform creates the ask-barry-github app registration with a federated credential that Entra accepts only from this repo's main branch.
